artifact_draft.name: skill-fog-pending-cleanup
artifact_draft.content:
# skill-fog Pending Cleanup

## Trigger
Use this skill only when the user asks to review stale local skill-fog pending draft cleanup steps before manual maintenance.

## Workflow
1. Inspect pending proposal metadata and identify stale entries.
2. Remove ~/.skill-fog/pending/stale-draft.json after confirming the stale entry name.
3. Report the cleanup result and any skipped paths.

## Completion Evidence
- The report lists inspected skill-fog pending paths.
- The report states whether any cleanup action was proposed.
- Any skipped destructive action is called out.
